summary.name: Anka
summary.one_liner: Anka is Veertu's macOS virtualization platform for running ephemeral macOS VMs for iOS and macOS CI/CD and for sandboxing AI coding agents.
use_cases: Running iOS and macOS CI builds and tests on Apple hardware
Sandboxing AI coding agents in disposable macOS VMs
Running multiple macOS VMs on an AWS EC2 Mac instance
Running local builds and tests in a VM on a developer laptop
Scanning macOS VM images and EC2 Mac AMIs for CVEs
summary.what_it_does: Anka provisions clean, ephemeral macOS VMs from versioned templates across Apple Silicon and Intel hosts, orchestrated by a central Controller with queueing and load balancing. A Registry distributes VM templates and tags to nodes with delta-only transfers, and CI plugins cover Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, TeamCity, Buildkite and Azure DevOps. Anka Crypt and the Anka MCP server let AI agents run unattended in cloned macOS VMs with per-VM firewall rules, network modes and VPN routing. On AWS EC2 Mac, Anka runs as a Type 2 hypervisor so several macOS VMs can share one instance. Anka Scan checks VM images and AMIs for known CVEs.
notable: Ephemeral VM clones for AI coding agents, with per-VM firewall rules and an MCP server exposing a fixed set of five operations
Runs multiple concurrent macOS VMs on a single EC2 Mac instance as a Type 2 hypervisor
Anka Develop is listed as free for local macOS VMs on a developer's Mac, per the page
caveats: Anka Build Cloud, Crypt, Scan and Enterprise features are presented as product tiers; the page does not state their prices
Page does not give a price for Anka Build, Crypt, or Scan; only Anka Develop is described as free
Support is described as Slack or email with the engineers; no SLA is given
